text: Two robbers hit the wrong bank. The Illuminati's. The plan was perfect. Masks. Bags. Zero brain cells. But the vault had no money. Just a giant golden eye. It opened, and it knew everything. Their names. Their passwords. Their search history. Instead of calling the police, the Illuminati offered them a job. Now they run the world. Badly. That's why everything is like this. Explains a lot, right? What did they break first?
